__NOTOC__
The '''curiosity box''' is a blue, blockquote-style division for additional context on classic (wikitext) content pages. Two templates build it: <code><nowiki>{{Curiosity}}</nowiki></code> opens the box and <code><nowiki>{{End special}}</nowiki></code> closes it. Ordinary wikitext inside — paragraphs, lists, math, code and links — renders as usual.

== Usage ==

<syntaxhighlight lang="wikitext">
{{Curiosity}}
The derivative of a constant is zero, because a constant does not change.
{{End special}}
</syntaxhighlight>

A box can hold several paragraphs, a list, math or code:

<syntaxhighlight lang="wikitext">
{{Curiosity}}
A short remark.

* first point
* second point
{{End special}}
</syntaxhighlight>

Always close the box with <code><nowiki>{{End special}}</nowiki></code>. A box left open swallows the rest of the page.

== Appearance ==

The box is styled by the <code>.curiosity</code> class in [[MediaWiki:Common.css]]:

* a blue left bar and a pale blue background, like a quotation;
* a round '''?''' badge in the left margin.

The templates emit only <code><nowiki><div class="curiosity"></nowiki></code> and <code><nowiki></div></nowiki></code>; all styling lives in the site CSS, so the box follows the skin and dark mode.

== Related special divisions ==

{| class="wikitable"
|-
! Opener !! Closer !! Purpose
|-
| <code><nowiki>{{Curiosity}}</nowiki></code> || <code><nowiki>{{End special}}</nowiki></code> || Additional context (this box)
|-
| <code><nowiki>{{Hidden solution}}</nowiki></code> || <code><nowiki>{{End hidden}}</nowiki></code> || Collapsible worked solution
|-
| <code><nowiki>{{Hidden proof}}</nowiki></code> || <code><nowiki>{{End hidden}}</nowiki></code> || Collapsible proof
|-
| <code><nowiki>{{Hidden example}}</nowiki></code> || <code><nowiki>{{End hidden}}</nowiki></code> || Collapsible example
|-
| <code><nowiki>{{Hidden explanation}}</nowiki></code> || <code><nowiki>{{End hidden}}</nowiki></code> || Collapsible explanation
|}

<code><nowiki>{{End solution}}</nowiki></code> redirects to <code><nowiki>{{End hidden}}</nowiki></code>.
